title: Guard job result
description: Machine-readable result.json uploaded by every example or quick-start job, success or failure.

trigger.description: How this run was started. Typical values: workflow_dispatch, schedule.

target_repo.description: Repository that was checked out and tested, owner/name.

target_ref.description: Branch, tag, or SHA that was tested.

path.description: Example script or documented path that this job exercised.

image.description: Container image used to run the job.

job_status.description: GitHub job conclusion for this result.
